R6C-bear-atv-0001.name: 3.8 km SE of Jalun Lake
R6C-bear-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6C-bear-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Branch 57A); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2007 (19 years old), 40 m SW: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
SW facing slope, 15 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 90 m E: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

seasonRows.notes: MU 6-13 is not listed in the Region 6 black bear rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 116 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.91681, -132.83444, where the truck road ends (Branch 57A); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.4 km on Branch 57A by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 140 m NW, climb about 28 m.

Hunt: black bear, season: VERIFY. Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-13, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 28 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
